instruction: A candid documentary photograph, medium shot, looking into the open back of an ambulance. Inside, the woman with blonde dreadlocks (R1) in a red paramedic uniform sits on the left, leaning forward to reach her hand toward a blue medical bag. The man with short red hair (R2), also in a red paramedic uniform, sits on the right, holding the blue medical bag on his lap and looking down at it. The interior of the ambulance has light green shelving. Natural daylight illuminates the scene, highlighting the red uniforms and blue bag.
